title: Read logs and rollout state
summary: Logs show the program's messages. Rollout status reports progress while a Deployment changes its Pods.
introduction: Logs show the program's messages. Rollout status reports progress while a Deployment changes its Pods. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain read logs and rollout state
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Logs show the program's messages. Rollout status reports progress while a Deployment changes its Pods.

blocks.code:
kubectl logs deployment/club-web
kubectl rollout status deployment/club-web
blocks.title: Read logs and rollout state

blocks.text: The first command reads selected container logs; the second observes the Deployment rollout. Output depends on the local cluster state.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Find an error message without copying any secret values.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A successful rollout does not prove every user journey works.
For more detail later, use this [Kubernetes further reading](https://kubernetes.io/docs/tutorials/kubernetes-basics/).
